premises.text: City leaders make decisions in the dark despite huge service budgets
premises.evidence_span: when it comes to decision-making local governments tap in the dark

premises.text: Municipal data is trapped in legacy silos, Excel files, and paper, making manual aggregation slow and costly
premises.evidence_span: The problem is the data is trapped in silos. Cities have many different legacy systems. Sometimes data is scattered across Excel files or only exists on paper

premises.text: The platform turns data from any legacy system into reports and actionable insights
premises.evidence_span: We take data from any existing legacy system and produce reports and actionable insights that governments can use to reach their goals

premises.text: The platform is modular and aligned with city services
premises.evidence_span: The Politea platform is modular and aligned with the city services, ranging from childcare to fire departments to infrastructure

premises.text: A data bridge installed on client servers queries legacy databases daily and digitizes paper records as a service
premises.evidence_span: The data bridge is a standalone part of our software that is installed on the client server. We connect it to the databases of the legacy systems and run queries on a daily basis

premises.text: Politea meets European localization requirements that US GovTech rivals cannot
premises.evidence_span: US-based GovSec startups, they just can't meet European localization requirements. Politeca does all of it.

premises.text: Regionally distributed on-site sales teams, modular pricing below procurement thresholds, and political networks drive adoption
premises.evidence_span: We do that by running regionally distributed sales teams to convince customers on site. Our modular pricing helps winning contracts below procurement thresholds. And we scale through political networks and social proof.

premises.text: A SaaS model charges a one-time setup fee and an annual license fee
premises.evidence_span: We run a software as a service business model with a one-time setup fee and an annual license fee

value.text: City leaders get reports and actionable insights to reach their goals
value.evidence_span: produce reports and actionable insights that governments can use to reach their goals

secondary_value.text: Data-empowered decisions improve millions of citizens' lives
secondary_value.evidence_span: all city leaders across Europe make data-empowered decisions, improving the life of millions of their citizens

notes: Partition matches a need/product/money triad; justified because the sales motion and fee structure ('regionally distributed sales teams', 'setup fee and an annual license fee') are revisable without touching the data bridge, and the silo problem is a standalone market assumption. 50 leads and 3 paying cities excluded as traction; EUR 1.6B market size is framing; team credentials not plainly causal, excluded per 4.2. Childcare module kept inside the modularity premise (v1.3.2 4.1(5)).

meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.2; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.
